meta.title: Memory disclosure gate
meta.description: Per-session control over how far memory retrieval may reach: workspace-only by default, with a composer toggle that widens it to global. Blocks out-of-scope engram_* calls before dispatch.

ui.titleWorkspace: Memory disclosure: this workspace only. engram_* may read the current workspace's memory store; click to widen to global.
ui.titleGlobal: Memory disclosure: global. engram_* may reach the private and shared stores across workspaces; click to narrow back.
